channel.description: Latest articles from Ocean News & Technology Magazine (oceannews.com)

item.title: Teledyne Marine Launches SeaBat T51 Integrated Dual Head Systems to Boost Survey Efficiency
item.description: At Oceanology International (Oi26), Teledyne Marine will introduce new additions to its SeaBat T-Series sonar portfolio, offering Integrated Dual Head (IDH) capability to the SeaBat T51 multibeam echosounder series, extending dual head performance to both surface vessel and deepwater ROV deployments.

item.title: HydroSurv Delivers REAV-25 USV to Strengthen Skanska Norway’s Uncrewed Survey Operations
item.description: HydroSurv has announced the sale and delivery of its latest REAV-25 uncrewed surface vessel (USV) to Skanska Norway AS, marking a significant milestone in Skanska’s expansion of uncrewed survey capability for infrastructure projects across the country.

item.title: JDR Appoints Former UK Trade Commissioner as Deputy CEO
item.description: JDR Cable Systems (JDR), the global subsea cable supplier and service provider, part of the TFKable Group, has appointed former UK Trade Commissioner Jonathan Knott CMG as Deputy Chief Executive Officer, marking a significant step in the company’s continued expansion and long-term growth strategy. item.title: BOEM’s Marine Minerals Information System Data Services Are Relocating
item.description: The Bureau of Ocean Energy Management’s Marine Minerals Information System data services are relocating to the Azure Cloud Environment on March 6, 2026.

item.title: ELWIND Launches Bird Survey for Offshore Wind Project Area in Latvia
item.description: The Latvian–Estonian offshore wind energy project ELWIND has launched an extensive study of migratory birds to assess the potential impact on bird populations within the project area. ELWIND has signed a contract with the Estonian company “Workboats Consulting OÜ”, which, together with “BioConsult SH GmbH & Co. KG” and the Estonian Ornithological Society, will conduct bird studies in Latvian waters over a two-year period.

item.title: BOEM Releases Five Beaufort Sea Seismic Survey Datasets
item.description: In alignment with President Trump’s Executive Order 14303, “Restoring Gold Standard Science,” the Bureau of Ocean Energy Management’s Alaska Outer Continental Shelf Region has released five 3D seismic survey datasets from the Beaufort Sea, expanding public access to legacy geologic information that supports industry analysis, academic research and Alaska energy planning.

item.title: Ocean Power Technologies Highlights Strategic Relevance of Autonomous Maritime Systems Amid Heightened Regional Tensions
item.description: Ocean Power Technologies, Inc. (OPT), a provider of autonomous maritime systems and offshore power solutions, underscored the growing strategic importance of persistent maritime domain awareness and offshore infrastructure protection as instability in the Middle East places key global shipping corridors and energy assets under increased focus.

item.title: TotalEnergies Signs Agreement to Export 2 Mtpa of LNG for 20 years from the Alaska LNG Project
item.description: TotalEnergies has signed a preliminary agreement (Letter of Intent) with Glenfarne, the lead developer of the Alaska LNG project, for the long-term offtake of 2 million tons per year (Mtpa) of liquefied natural gas (LNG) over 20 years, subject to the project’s final investment decision.

item.title: Austal USA Launches Future USNS Lansing
item.description: Austal USA launched the Navy’s final Expeditionary Fast Transport, future USNS Lansing (EPF 16) in Mobile, Ala., February 25, 2026. The US Navy’s 16th Expeditionary Fast Transport (EPF), christened in early January, is now docked pier side for final outfitting and system activation in preparation for sea trials later this year.

item.title: National Marine Autonomy Accelerator Launched to Drive Innovation and Opportunity
item.description: Babcock is partnering with Tech Southwest to launch a new National Marine Autonomy Accelerator to support high-growth companies working in autonomous marine systems and technologies.
